# Mercatus Center

> > Research and analysis on free-market policy solutions for healthcare, government spending, regulatory reform, and economic growth from the Mercatus Center at George Mason University.

The Mercatus Center produces expert commentary, research, and policy recommendations on economic policy issues including healthcare reform (ACA, Medicare, Medicaid), corporate welfare and cronyism, tax reform, and regulatory policy. Featured scholars include Veronique de Rugy and Jason Fichtner.

## Key Topics

- Affordable Care Act (ACA)
- Healthcare policy and reform
- Medicare and Medicaid reform
- Government spending and fiscal policy
- Corporate welfare and cronyism
- Regulatory reform
- Certificate of Public Need (COPN)
- Tax reform and economic growth
- Entitlement spending
- Healthcare competition and markets
- Special interests and lobbying
- Federal Reserve policy
- Trade policy
- Congressional Budget Office analysis

## Healthcare Policy and Reform

- [Medicare for All: A Non-Solution to a Non-Problem](https://www.mercatus.org/economic-insights/expert-commentary/medicare-all-non-solution-non-problem): Critique of Medicare for All single-payer healthcare proposal
- [How to Repeal the Affordable Care Act: A Roadmap](https://www.mercatus.org/economic-insights/expert-commentary/how-repeal-affordable-care-act-roadmap): Legislative strategy roadmap for ACA repeal using reconciliation
- [New Data Shows Large Insurer Losses on ACA Plans](https://www.mercatus.org/economic-insights/expert-commentary/new-data-shows-large-insurer-losses-aca-plans): CMS data analysis on 2014 ACA insurer losses and reinsurance subsidies
- [Health Insurance Mandates Show Why Regulatory Reform is Needed](https://www.mercatus.org/economic-insights/expert-commentary/health-insurance-mandates-show-why-regulatory-reform-needed): ACA essential health benefits mandate reduces consumer choice analysis
- [Medicaid Expansion Is Expensive for Both States and the Poor](https://www.mercatus.org/economic-insights/expert-commentary/medicaid-expansion-expensive-both-states-and-poor): ACA Medicaid expansion impact on state budgets and federal funding
- [Virginia Policy Puts Special Interests above Patients](https://www.mercatus.org/economic-insights/expert-commentary/virginia-policy-puts-special-interests-above-patients): Virginia COPN law creates healthcare barriers in Shenandoah Valley region
- [Toward Digital Health Biographies](https://www.mercatus.org/economic-insights/expert-commentary/toward-digital-health-biographies): Digital Health Biographies proposal to improve EHR technology

## Medicare and Entitlement Reform

- [The Truth about Medicare](https://www.mercatus.org/economic-insights/expert-commentary/truth-about-medicare): Medicare sustainability analysis and Romney-Ryan reform proposals
- [Competing Medicare Plans Would Be a Step in the Right Direction](https://www.mercatus.org/economic-insights/expert-commentary/competing-medicare-plans-would-be-step-right-direction): Wyden-Ryan Medicare reform plan analysis using market competition

## Corporate Welfare and Cronyism

- [Foxconn Deal Makes the American Economy Less Great](https://www.mercatus.org/economic-insights/expert-commentary/foxconn-deal-makes-american-economy-less-great): Analysis of Wisconsin's Foxconn tax incentives and corporate welfare
- [Cronyism, The American Way](https://www.mercatus.org/economic-insights/expert-commentary/cronyism-american-way): Institutional economics analysis of cronyism using Acemoglu-Robinson framework
- [How Cronyism is Hurting the Economy](https://www.mercatus.org/economic-insights/expert-commentary/how-cronyism-hurting-economy): Jason Brennan video on corporate welfare and political connections
- [A Farm Bill Bait and Switch](https://www.mercatus.org/economic-insights/expert-commentary/farm-bill-bait-and-switch): 2013 Farm Bill analysis criticizing agricultural subsidy protection

## Tax Reform and Economic Growth

- [Explaining Pro-Growth Tax Reform](https://www.mercatus.org/podcasts/explaining-pro-growth-tax-reform): De Rugy and Fichtner discuss pro-growth tax reform priorities
- [Three Tax Reform Priorities that Should Top Congress's List](https://www.mercatus.org/podcasts/three-tax-reform-priorities-should-top-congresss-list): De Rugy and Beach on congressional tax reform implementation priorities

## Government Spending and Fiscal Policy

- [What Will It Take to Solve Puerto Rico's Debt Crisis?](https://www.mercatus.org/economic-insights/expert-commentary/what-will-it-take-solve-puerto-ricos-debt-crisis): Puerto Rico debt default analysis with New Zealand recovery comparison
- [Partying Hipsters, Shrimp Fight Club and Monkeys in Hamster Balls](https://www.mercatus.org/economic-insights/expert-commentary/partying-hipsters-shrimp-fight-club-and-monkeys-hamster-balls): Jeff Flake's Wastebook highlights federal spending waste examples

## Regulatory and Financial Policy

- [Federal Reserve Reform: Monetary Policy and Beyond](https://www.mercatus.org/economic-insights/event-videos/federal-reserve-reform-monetary-policy-and-beyond): Event video on Fed reform, NGDP targeting, and capital requirements
- [New Report Finds Fundamental Flaws in America's Proxy Advisory System; Offers Three Policy Recommendations to Fix Broken System](https://www.mercatus.org/economic-insights/expert-commentary/new-report-finds-fundamental-flaws-americas-proxy-advisory): SEC proxy voting rules and corporate governance reform recommendations
- [Trump Trade Data Proposal Defies Common Sense, Honest Accounting](https://www.mercatus.org/economic-insights/expert-commentary/trump-trade-data-proposal-defies-common-sense-honest-accounting): Critique of Trump administration's trade deficit accounting proposals
